name: Paramedium: A Noise in the Attic
source:
What's more dangerous, the living or the dead?
Spend the night as a Paramedium Cleric and see if you have what it takes to survive.

[From the [url=https://www.aglstudioart.com/paramedium]official website[/url]]
translation:
生者和死者哪个更危险？
作为一名超灵媒牧师过夜，看看你是否有生存所需的能力。

[摘自[url=https://www.aglstudioart.com/paramedium]官网[/url]]
